title: Shared testing for meal-plan shopping list creation
description: Add and run the spec-mandated automated coverage for CookbookCore scaling, orchestration service behavior, and MealPlanDetailView create-flow wiring, including project regeneration before the test gate.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookCore tests cover double-based scaling, preservation of text quantities and non-ingredient items, and factor `1.0` identity behavior.
CookbookApp tests cover service cases for scaling, missing servings, missing reference quantity, aggregation, provenance ordering, duplicate names, and empty plans.
MealPlanDetailView tests cover removal of the stub flow, presentation of the create alert, and successful confirmation plus View-sheet behavior.
`xcodegen generate` and the relevant `xcodebuild test` gate are executed, with failures resolved or reported precisely.
